result.summary: The image shows a residential street with sidewalks on both sides but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control at the visible intersection. Utility poles obstruct the sidewalk path on the left, and there is a lack of visible ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corner.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space or priority.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the path of the sidewalk, narrowing the usable width.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps for wheelchair or stroller access at the corner, creating a barrier for mobility-impaired users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: This is a residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. While a basic marked crosswalk is present, the environment lacks traffic calming measures and high-visibility pedestrian infrastructure.

hazards.name: Low-visibility crosswalk
hazards.description: The transverse line markings are thin and may not be easily visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking at the corner.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.
